_comment: REPOSITORY TEMPLATE - offline recorder replay/seal workflow placeholders. There is NO runner that consumes this file directly: replay and seal are public CLI commands. Fill REPLACE_ME values from an ACTUAL recorded session on your own store; a session id that no run produced must never be written into an instance config. Live gateway recording stays LIVE_NOT_RUN unless an authorized capture run exists.

record.launcher: vnpy-recorder (console entry; see README.md Recording section)
record.note: offline/synthetic-labelled input only; no gateway, account, or network

request.asset_class: REPLACE_ME (defaults honestly to OTHER + unknown units)
